patch.value: Fix runGraph projected result narrowing and bump pm-cli to 2026.8.3

pm-cli 2026.8.3 changed the SDK runGraph return type from GraphResult to ProjectedGraphResult (GraphResult plus an output projection declaration). The generic wrapper runPmGraph in src/index.ts casts that to an unresolved type parameter T, which fails typecheck with TS2352. Fix: remove the type parameter, return the projected result, and narrow on the subcommand discriminant at the single impact call site with a CommandError guard. Also bump the pm-cli pin to 2026.8.3 in devDependencies and peerDependencies with a committed lockfile refresh. Supersedes dependabot PR 51.
npm run typecheck, build, test, coverage, and changelog:check all pass; no cast or any introduced; pin at 2026.8.3 in package.json and package-lock.json

Merged in unbraind/pm-graph#53. The 2026.8.3 engine returns the ProjectedGraphResult union and no longer exports GraphResult/GraphImpactResult, so the return type is now derived from runGraph via Awaited<ReturnType<typeof runGraph>> rather than re-declared locally where a hand-maintained copy would drift. That also removed the generic type parameter and its as-T assertion, so no type assertion remains on this path; callers narrow on the subcommand discriminant. typecheck, build, tests and release:check all pass against 2026.8.3. Superseded dependabot PR #51 (2026.7.31) was closed with an explanation. Bots: CodeRabbit, Greptile, DeepScan, Hound and semgrep all green with no actionable findings; Sourcery was rate-limited.
